title: Miguel was the best historian ever
text: Miguel met us promptly at appointed time.  A little hard from the directions where to met but we figured it out. His tour and info on the cathedral La Família was extensive and so interesting. Our trip then to park Güell was also fascinating with so much great info. Walking around the old city with stories of the history of Spain really opened our eyes to what Spain  is about. Found a great place for lunch and we finished the day with a tour of the old cathedral Barcelona . Just a great day with a really nice man
author: cynthia h
